## Purpose

Describe the single problem this pull request solves and the user-facing impact.

## Scope

- [ ] Public website or accessibility
- [ ] Documentation or localization
- [ ] Release metadata or provenance
- [ ] Validation or CI
- [ ] Support, security or issue workflow
- [ ] Other public-repository maintenance

## Consistency checks

- [ ] Windows and macOS guidance remain consistent where applicable.
- [ ] English and Bahasa Indonesia content remain aligned where applicable.
- [ ] Release metadata refers only to an existing official release and assets.
- [ ] Canonical, `hreflang`, sitemap and structured-data values remain consistent.
- [ ] No proprietary DSP details, credentials, activation data, customer information or private project content are included.

## Validation

List the commands or checks performed and their results.

```text
Example: .\tools\validate-public-release.ps1
```

## Visual evidence

For visible website changes, include focused before/after screenshots at relevant desktop and mobile widths. Remove personal or confidential information first.

## Risk and rollback

Describe any compatibility, legal, privacy, security or release-distribution risk and how the change can be reverted.
